title: With our Whole Hearts - Taking Refuge
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the three refuges of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, starting from a Dhammapada verse about false and true refuge. Nomon tells how the Buddha ordained his son Rahula with the three refuges, which prompts the Buddha's father Suddhodana to object and the Buddha to make one of the first monastic rules. Nomon then goes through the Pali chant, where gacchami carries a sense of going with understanding, and the Chinese characters behind "I take refuge," which say "return and rely." Groups of three close the evening by asking what taking refuge means for each person.
